concept: Ask your codebase. We drop into a live graphify session where a builder stops grepping and asks for the path between two symbols. We name the gap grep leaves, show how graphify actually works (local tree-sitter parse, a real graph not embeddings, every edge EXTRACTED or INFERRED), show the three real files it writes, then pay it off with the money shot: a single green path lighting up through the graph as the ANSWER. The graph appears exactly once, as the climax, not as a node tour. Close on the thesis and the wordmark so the loop rhymes with the open.
money_shot_note: Scene 5 (the diagram): the path lights up from DigestAuth through to Response, EXTRACTED edges solid and one INFERRED edge dashed, with a scale-punch on the cut. It is the peak because it is the literal answer to the question typed in scene 1.
transition_strategy: Hard cuts throughout; the one reserved cut_kick fires on the cut INTO the money shot only. Motion carries through the cuts (scenes enter already moving).
music_direction: Electronic bed, forward and clean. The single sub_impact foley transient lands on the money-shot cut, not on every boundary.
